name: The Sadducees
overview: The Sadducees were a Jewish sect known for their denial of the resurrection, as clearly stated in Matthew 22:23 and Luke 20:27, where they challenge Jesus on this doctrine. Jesus warns believers to be cautious of their influence, grouping their 'leaven' with that of the Pharisees in Matthew 16:6, indicating the spiritual danger of their erroneous teachings. This highlights the importance of holding firmly to the truth of resurrection and eternal life as revealed in Scripture.
